capability: A replayable record of every agent step
title: Every step leaves a mark.

hook.picture: Close on the whale watching a pod finish a run. The line behind the pod fades out as it goes. The pod shows ✓; a dashboard pod downstream turns a rust ✕.
hook.words: The agent said it was done.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It said done. Nobody could replay what it did.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: engineer on call after an overnight agent run

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three pods run in parallel lanes, each line erasing itself. First failure downstream: ✕ (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The run leaves no trail behind it.

stakes.body: Every failure becomes a guessing game. The fix takes hours, and the same bad step runs again tonight.

solution_hint: Write each step down. Go on green.

metaphor.body: The pod's line leaves a strip of ticks under it, one per step, and a gate after each step lets the line go on only when it glows green. Rust alarm.

steps.picture: The pod swims again. Now each step drops a tick onto a strip under the line, and the strip stays. Strip: Write · Read · Go.
steps.words: Write each step down as it happens.
steps.sound: Signature click, in tune, per tick

steps.picture: A gate after each step. Green steps pass with a glow. On a red step the gate shuts and the line stops and waits.
steps.words: Not green? It stops and waits.
steps.sound: Muted thud on the shut gate

steps.picture: Push-in: a second whale slides along the tick strip, lighting each tick as it reads. It adds none and changes none.
A person pod drops a verdict chip into the shut gate. The gate turns green and the line moves on.
steps.words: A person can give the verdict.

steps.picture: The tick strip glows from end to end, labelled.

real_case.claim: A typed gate decides if work proceeds; a durable tape records each step; /api/query reads it without writing; /api/signal takes a human verdict. Fail closed, GREEN only.

honest_limit.picture: A pod reaches off the line through a side door and sends a message out. No tick lands. The strip looks complete and every gate is green.
honest_limit.words: Off the line? No mark at all.

not_this.body: A full tape is not the whole story.

ending_pattern.body: The whale scrubs the tick strip backwards like a tape, finds the one bad step and fixes it. The run replays clean.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's self-erasing line now leaves a strip the whale can rewind.

end_belief.body: Keep the record. Move on only on green.

sound.problem_motif: The same click reversed and smeared

score_self.reason: The self-erasing line is a strong, readable felt image, and rewinding is a clean callback. MOVE carries three ideas (record, gate, human verdict), so a stranger may remember only the record.
